run_create_finetune_dataset_cli: run the CLI script to convert ASE atoms files into ASE database datasets for finetuning
run_launch_processing: run launch_processing to convert ASE atoms files in a directory into parallel ASE database shards
run_compute_normalizer_and_linear_refere: run compute_normalizer_and_linear_reference to compute force RMS and linear reference coefficients from an ASE database
run_compute_lin_ref: run compute_lin_ref to compute linear reference coefficients from atomic numbers and energies via least squares
run_write_ase_db: run write_ase_db to write ASE atoms objects with energy and forces into an ASE database file
